description: This file defines the 'Teller' entity class in the Fineract project, including its fields, relationships, and methods for creating and updating a Teller from JSON input.

classes.name: Teller
classes.description: Entity class representing a teller in the organization, with fields for office, accounts, name, description, validity dates, status, and associated cashiers, along with methods to create and update instances.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new Teller instance from JSON command parameters and associated office.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current Teller entity with new values from JSON command, tracking changed fields.

methods.name: officeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated Office.

methods.name: initializeLazyCollections
methods.description: Ensures lazy-loaded collections are initialized to avoid LazyInitializationException.
